scene: 箱わなの横で、銃口を下に向けたまま駆除に臨むハンター（CHAR-05）。駆除の直接描写はしない。

fences.label: キャラプロンプト（1:1）:
fences.text: (CHAR-05 再利用) Cute cartoon character design, thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, large expressive eyes, children's animation style. A full-body Japanese local hunter in his 60s with short grey hair and a grey stubble, an orange cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, a small backpack, standing toward the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle, his face clearly visible. He holds a rifle with both hands, its muzzle pointed straight down at the ground, eyebrows driven down hard and pulled together, eyes narrowed to a hard unblinking stare, mouth pressed into a flat grim line with the jaw tight, a bead of sweat running down his temple, tense and resolute, NOT calm, NOT smiling. The rifle is not pointed at anyone, do NOT draw the rifle held across the chest. No lettering, no badge, no logo. A very large head about one third of the total height, a short compact torso and short stubby arms and legs, roughly three heads tall. Do NOT draw him with realistic adult proportions — not four, five, six or seven heads tall. Full body. Transparent background, real alpha transparency. 1:1 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.

directions: → 編集者指示: 背景は ASSET-132_bg.png を1.0→1.15倍に寄せて使う、キャラは新規の ASSET-135_char.png。ハンターを左に置き、動かさない。駆除の瞬間は描かず、次のカットへ暗転でつなぐ。中央に「すぐに駆除」を白字で表示し、「駆除」だけ赤字。
